At first, no one thought that the "Pale" virus
would be so contagious ... when we noticed,
everything was too late.
This virus exploits immunodeficiency in a gene of
the human body, and we can't do anything. General
drugs and vaccines have no effect on "Pale"
Generally speaking, such a deadly virus will
naturally stop spreading after losing the majority
of the population, but "Pale" is more and more
raging with the spread through air and ocean.
We have no choice but to start genetic
engineering, to try and correct our genes...
But it will only be reflected in the
offspring, we don't have so much time.
At this time, someone made a bold assumption that
certain parasites would modify the host's DNA to
mutate the host.
Can this be used as a breakthrough in research?
Good idea, but what kind of "parasites" can do it?
We experimented much for this, but nothing
succeeded. At this moment, the upper level told us
to come to this building to study a goo organism.
The upper layer insisted they artificially been
created for this genetic engineering. They were
initially like glass slag in glue, and they had
the magical ability to change genes immediately.
Those goo creatures can rearrange your genes by
covering the human body and breaking down cells...
but their effects are too significant,
and the subjects are all assimilated in the end.
The black latex beast will replace the entire
primitive wolf creature gene into the subject's
body, and all the subjects will become wolf-shaped
black latex beasts without exception.
Most importantly the subject's consciousness
will also merge with the black latex beast, and
their mind and body are no longer their own. We
call this process and the result "TRANSFUR".
In short, the person who completed the treatment
is no longer a person, but a member of the
slime organism,
which is not the desired result.
The experiment succeeded, but it also failed...
We sealed these black latex beasts, some continued
to study a few samples of black latex beasts that
might work, others went to study a white mutant...
It takes you a while to take in all of this.

recall the memory about the vigorous "flu". The
news said that it was just an ordinary "flu"...
But it is precisely because of the "flu" that you
were kidnapped into this institute as a test
subject, but you have not been put into use yet,

researchers are missing, everything is scattered
in a mess, something must have happened.
